title: Fiesta Luau en la Playa (Luau Beach Party)
names_seen: Fiesta Luau en la Playa (Luau Beach Party)

facts.statement: A community event called a luau beach party was held at Playa Azul, with players gathering at the sea shore to dance, turn into crabs, set off fireworks, trade collections and socialize.
facts.quote: Todo mundo estará llegando a las orillas del mar en Playa Azul para bailar, convertirse en cangrejos

facts.statement: The luau event ran Thursday 24 March 2011 at 15:00 PST (23:00 CET) for US and Latin America, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Jueves 24 de marzo, 2011 15:00hrs. PST (23:00 CET) (EE.UU. y Latino America) Servidor 1

facts.statement: A second run of the luau event was held Friday 25 March 2011 at 09:00 PST / 17:00 UTC for UK and Europe, on Server 1.
facts.quote: viernes 25 de marzo, 2011 09:00hrs. PST / 17:00hrs. UTC (UK y Europa) Servidor 1

facts.statement: Community Ambassadors attended the luau to ask trivia questions, dance on the sea and answer players' questions about the game.
facts.quote: Nuestros Embajadores de la comunidad estarán presentes para hacer preguntas triviales, bailar sobre el mar

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Fiesta Luau en la Playa (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event post announcing a luau beach party at Playa Azul, held on two dates in March 2011 on Server 1, with Community Ambassadors hosting trivia, dancing and Q&A. The post also says outfits can be obtained by completing quests, redeeming web codes, spending in-game currency, or buying from the Station Cash catalog, and that pets have items too. The post date is only given as a relative age ('2 months, 1 week ago') in the capture, so the exact posting date is unknown.
